results.overview: Go behind the scenes with in-depth interviews featuring Curry Barker and the cast

results.title: Bird of Paradise
results.overview: Eagerly wanting to have a last bloom of her youth, Mama Yeung conceals her stubborn husband and rebellious son, and steps into the new splendid world of pole dance. Yet, this secret has been accidentally revealed, putting her into a dilemma between fulfilling her family’s needs and pursuing her dream…

results.title: Compliance
results.overview: On the eve of a landmark deal for a major tech startup, they're faced with a sexual assault controversy that threatens to become a PR disaster. As new hire Sam works to contain the fallout, it becomes clear that not all is as it seems, and she quickly finds herself in a game of cat and mouse with a criminal organization taking aim at the company and their investors.

results.title: Murder in the Dark
results.overview: A blind waitress at a dining-in-the-dark restaurant becomes the sole witness to a murder, making her the next target of a killer determined to eliminate the only person who could identify him.

results.overview: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

results.title: The Watchmaker
results.overview: Stockholm, February 1968. A petty theft spirals when Sebbe and Adam accidentally destroy the pocket watch meant for an unknown client. Desperate, they turn to watchmaker Karl for an urgent repair, but their anxiety soon shifts to a darker fear. Confined to Karl’s cramped workshop, distrust and rising paranoia transform their predicament into a claustrophobic psychological chamber play. As midnight nears, buried truths and old revenge surface.

results.title: Punk State
results.overview: Seven guests arrive for an exclusive performance inside a remote theatre, unaware that they are the show.

results.title: An Unstable Marriage
results.overview: A woman investigates clues into her husbands disappearance at the equestrian center they run together.

results.title: The Spirit Lock
results.overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

results.title: Tabby Daly
results.overview: As the potato blight tears through a rural community, a charitable woman helps young boys emigrate in search of a better life. But as quiet doubts begin to surface, questions emerge about her true intentions.

results.title: The Streets of "Mean Streets"
results.overview: A short companion piece that offers a present day walk through of Little Italy, now juxtaposing modern scenes with the world depicted in Mean Streets to illuminate its cultural and historical roots.

results.title: Naquerar
results.overview: Naquerar revisits a groundbreaking flamenco manifesto, connecting Roma memory, dance, and anti-racist resistance across generations and geographies.

results.title: Maple Leaf Pro: Multiverse 2026
results.overview: MLP: Multiverse 2026 – The Global Showcase at Slam Fest Las Vegas live on TrillerTV, streaming straight from the iconic Pearl Theater within Palms Casino Resort.  Multiverse stands as a centerpiece of Slam Fest 2026, the five-day global wrestling festival. This event brings the collaborative vision of Scott D'Amore to life, featuring the elite talent of MLP alongside champions and stars from the world's leading promotions.

results.title: Gema Senandika
results.overview: Dika, a vocational high school graduate, has been the sole breadwinner for his family since his mother’s passing, as his father—despite being physically capable—has never provided any financial support. Now of marriageable age, Dika faces a dilemma: marry and force his younger sibling to take over the burden of supporting the family, or break the "sandwich generation" cycle at the cost of his own future and love life. Ultimately, Dika chooses to continue supporting his family, letting go of his girlfriend so she can marry another man.

results.title: Othello
results.overview: Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it's all part of a scheme orchestrated by bitter ensign Iago. Filmed live at the Theatre Royal Haymarket in London especially for the big screen.

results.title: CAMPEÓN
results.overview: Emma's life violently unravels as she is both the obsession of a narcissistic addict, and the fault line between identical brothers.

results.title: The Basics of Philosophy
results.overview: A repressed philosophy professor, Dr. John Jorissen, is employed at Ridgemont College, a small liberal arts school in the American Midwest. He teaches an introductory course and is writing a book on renowned Dutch philosopher Baruch Spinoza. Haunted by a long-buried transgression and the sudden return of its victim, he descends into a crisis of guilt, desire, and spiritual reckoning.

results.title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 2

results.overview: The second night of Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 took place on April 20, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The event was headlined by an IWGP Tag Team Championship #1 Contendership Match between Bishamon (Hirooki Goto & YOSHI-HASHI) and Great-O-Khan & HENARE.

results.title: The Match-Stick Flame 3: Red Mafia
results.overview: Dalton, who's now a bounty hunter, finishes his assignment given by DEA Agent Prasad to take down the remaining Lunada Bay Gang members in Rancho Palos Verdes, CA. Dalton is a Navy Seal veteran with PTSD who is seeking alternative medicine strategies with karate Sensei Darryl Vidal as well as traditional therapy. However, Dalton has to hunt down the Russian mob called Red Mafia to save Agent Prasad who was taken. Dalton reconnects with Chief Higgins, the Match-Stick Mobsters, and Jake in order to rescue Agent Prasad.

results.title: Suddenly Satan
results.overview: A sibling visit an abandoned hotel in search of their father's treasure. Initially, the terror is thought to be a hoax by a hotel guard hired to pose as a ghost, but things change when the spirit of a woman murdered in the hotel actually rises and haunts them. Now they must fight to survive this supernatural terror.
